Subject: Edge demarcation and control/data plane interface — ops handshake (v2)

Team —

Attaching an updated demarc diagram and a short checklist to drive tomorrow's ops handshake with Equinox. The goals for the call:

- Confirm the control-plane hops (where control traffic terminates on their side vs ours)
- Agree on egress proxy expectations (TLS termination, SNI passthrough behavior)
- Validate BGP / service IP plan for the inference fabric and fallbacks
- Identify any firewall exceptions the customer needs to request

Notes about the diagram (v2): I moved the upstream proxy into a distinct trust zone to make the bridging rules explicit, and I added an alternate egress route for degraded-throughput mode. See the drawio attached.

Ask: please review items marked "ops-check" and respond with edits or objections by EOD today so Marcus can fold into the final checklist for tomorrow's meeting.

Thanks,
Naomi

I pulled the diagram and left three inline comments where I think we should tighten the ACLs:

1) Control-plane ingress from Equinox management CIDR should be limited to ports 443 and 8443; no SSH.
2) KV-cache replication traffic is marked "internal" but will need a dedicated ACL between the inference nodes and the replication proxy when stretched across subnets.
3) Egress route priority table needs explicit fallthrough to the secondary NAT in case of IBGP flap — I added a suggested preference value in the drawio comments.

Small correction: on the checklist under "pre-call ops" change the item that says "confirm BGP peer IPs" to specify both primary and secondary peer addresses — customers sometimes only provide the primary.

I can join the call and present the control-plane ingress notes if you want.

- Irene

Thanks Naomi / Irene — good catches. A couple of implementation-level clarifications from the infra side:

- Egress proxy behavior: Equinox's proxy will need to support SNI passthrough for model download calls to third-party buckets; if they terminate TLS for other flows we should negotiate an allowlist so we can pin certs on our side for telemetry.
- Service IPs: If we assign service IPs from the 10.48.0.0/16 block for inference, make sure the route-map on their edge routers doesn't inadvertently NAT those to their tenant pool. The checklist should include a pre-cutover route review.
- Health probes: add a step to the ops-checklist to validate health probe source IPs (we should not rely on DNS names alone).

I also attached a quick sample config for the egress-proxy that matches our runtime expectations — it's a stub but should help the customer ops team align.

I can be on the call at 10a PT.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal DevOps Engineer, Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the quick reviews. I've incorporated Irene's ACL tightenings and Karthik's probe + SNI notes into a final ops checklist and regenerated the diagram (v2.1). Key callout changes:

- BGP: primary/secondary peers listed explicitly; failover preference clarified.
- ACLs: control-plane ingress limited to 443/8443 from Equinox management CIDR; no SSH as requested.
- KV replication: explicit ACL between inference nodes and replication proxy with port range 7000-7010.
- Egress degraded mode: added a clear, documented fallback route and a time-based failover threshold.
- Pre-cutover steps: added "route-table review" and "health-probe validation" items.

I've attached the final checklist and the new drawio. Please review quickly — if there are no objections I'll send this to Eli + their eng lead before tomorrow's 10a PT handshake and use it as the working agenda.
